name: Bhagat Singh
contribution: Became a powerful symbol of courage during India's freedom struggle.
Inspired many young people to think deeply about justice and independence.
Accepted great personal risk for the country at a very young age.
whyTheyMatter: He reminds us that courage should be guided by love for the nation and a sense of duty.

name: Subhas Chandra Bose
contribution: Led the Indian National Army during the freedom struggle.
Called on Indians to work boldly for independence.

name: Chandra Shekhar Azad
contribution: Worked with other revolutionaries for India's independence.

name: Mangal Pandey
contribution: Was a sepoy whose actions became linked with the 1857 uprising.
Is remembered as one of the early sparks of resistance to British rule.

name: Bal Gangadhar Tilak
contribution: Helped make swaraj, or self-rule, a powerful public idea.

contribution: Worked on India's space and missile programs.
